title: CDFD Runtime: Constraint-Driven Flux Dynamics and CDFL Execution Engine
description: Slim public command-line runtime for Constraint-Driven Flux Dynamics and CDFL. The active release provides deterministic CLI execution, CDFL lint/format/AST tooling, runtime finite-audit helpers, one canonical example model, one reproducible smoke experiment, VS Code CDFL language support, and focused tests. Outputs are deterministic toy-model diagnostics and software-audit artifacts, not empirical evidence, calibrated forecasts, or deployed decision systems.
